note: Ideas only, not facts. Every figure and claim must be researched and verified from pages opened during the run. Use an idea only if its key is not in ledger.json (12-week rule). Honour fit (fb, li or both; never both channels in one week), kind (data ideas need the latest release, with a new key per period) and near (ledger keys with overlapping subject: take a clearly different angle and different numbers). An idea may be reshaped with a clearly new angle under a new key. Weekly-changing data ideas go only in slots queued in the same run. Add up to 10 new ideas per run with the same fields.
